article.headline: Teodor Simic helps UT Arlington hold off Portland 89-85 at Rainbow Classic
article.description: — Teodor Simic led UT Arlington past Portland on Friday with 24 points off of the bench in an 89-85 victory at the Rainbow Classic.
article.linkText: Teodor Simic helps UT Arlington hold off Portland 89-85 at Rainbow Classic
article.story: HONOLULU -- — Teodor Simic led UT Arlington past Portland on Friday with 24 points off of the bench in an 89-85 victory at the Rainbow Classic. Simic added five rebounds for the Mavericks (2-0). Mier Panoam scored 19 points and added five rebounds and four steals. Niko Bundalo had 18 points and shot 7 of 11 from the field and 4 for 6 from the line. R.J. Nance finished with 25 points for the Pilots (1-1). Riley Parker added 18 points and Hunter Adam scored 18. Panoam’s free throw with 1:23 left in the second half gave UT Arlington the lead for good at 86-85. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
